caption:
“Democratic life implies recognizing that no one has all the answers and that differences do not prevent us from sharing a sincere concern for the good of the country.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Address to authorities and diplomatic corps, Lima (2026)

Via Vatican News, 11 November 2026
